A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed methodology and framework can help in the analysis of online discussions about controversial topics and the perception of social phenomena.
we have developed an analytical framework for the study of social phenomena in social media that is based on multidimensional data and sentiment analysis.
the proposed framework is useful to investigate the dynamics and evolution of social networks, and it is able to provide a multidimensional analysis of social phenomena.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sentiment-enhanced multidimensional social network analysis provides a new perspective for understanding social phenomena and for detecting and analyzing social biases.
the proposed analytical approach allows the investigation of complex social phenomena in an integrated manner, providing a comprehensive picture of the social network dynamics.
the proposed framework and methodology can be used in a variety of contexts to mine knowledge about complex and sensitive social phenomena.
